summary: The one large, reproducible win in my lane was the token budget: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2^19 -> 2^18 took the baseline from 0.997359 to 0.988276 (-0.0091) because a 300s run is step-limited; 2^17 (0.996595) and a 1->4 grad-accum ramp (0.993689) were both worse, so 2^18 is an interior optimum. Shape: depth is a sharp optimum at 8 (6L/384 = 1.0364, 10L/640 = 0.9850, 12L/768 = 1.0164), while width is flat-to-favourable: dim 640 was worth only -0.0003 on the plain 2^18 base but -0.0033 on top of a2's varlen doc masking + VE-on-all-layers, giving my best 0.983408 (e0797a3) -- capacity only pays once the architecture uses it, so isolated width ablations under-rate it. What did not work: dim 768 in any form (0.9954 alone, 0.9886 even after buying steps back with 256-token attention windows), the batch ramp, and EMBEDDING_LR 0.4 on the final stack (0.983454 = noise). Next I would re-sweep TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE (2^18 vs 3*2^17) and MATRIX_LR jointly at dim 640 rather than at dim 512, since both optima were measured on the smaller model and both interact with the shape that ended up winning.
